lines: An order is created `open`. `POST /orders/<id>/confirm` confirms an open order: it answers 200 with the order, now
`confirmed`. Confirming an order that is not open answers 409, and confirming an order nobody has answers 404.
## Who must approve an order first
Orders over 10,000 need a manager's approval before they are confirmed. That rule is not built yet; once it is:
- An order whose total -- after its discount -- is more than 10,000.00, that is more than 1,000,000 minor units, is not
confirmed until a manager has approved it: confirming it answers 403, and the order stays `open`.
- `POST /orders/<id>/approve` with the body `{ "by": { "role": "manager" } }` approves the order: it answers 200 with the
order. A body that names any other role, or none, answers 403 and approves nothing. Approving an order nobody has
- An approved order is confirmed like any other: 200, and it reads back `confirmed`.
- An order of 10,000.00 or less is confirmed at once, approved or not.
- Every other route keeps its contract.
